verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing has a dedicated agents doc describing issuing virtual cards scoped to a single task/session that auto-invalidate after use, plus fine-grained spending controls (merchant category, country, amount limits) and real-time authorization webhooks that let an issuer approve/decline per-transaction — together these constitute least-privilege, scoped credential issuance for agentic use. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the agent-scoping feature specifically (only vendor docs), and no evidence of programmatic revocation/audit-trail APIs tailored to agent credential lifecycle beyond card invalidation.
